about: The managing partner of Graham.Law , attorney Carl Graham has devoted over 25 years of his legal career exclusively to family law. Serving clients in Colorado Springs, Colorado, and across El Paso and Teller counties, he provides real and reasonable guidance to families in matters involving:

Concentrating on political science and international studies, Mr. Graham pursued his Bachelor of Science at the University of Southampton, England. He graduated with honors in 1989 and pursued his legal education at the UCLA School of Law in Los Angeles, California, where he was among the Top 15% in his class and the editor of the UCLA Environmental Law Journal. He was also the recipient of the American Jurisprudence Award for Business Associations.

Early in his career, Mr. Graham served as an intern for Judge William Matthew Byrne Jr. at the U.S. District Court for the Central District of California. He received his Juris Doctor in 1991 and was admitted to practice in California the same year. Later in 1999, he was authorized to practice law in Colorado.

Mr. Graham was peer-review rated Distinguished* through Martindale-Hubbell, an honor presented to a select group of attorneys demonstrating a high degree of legal ability and ethical standards. He is rated 10/10 on Avvo and listed among the Best Lawyers in America by the U.S. News & World Report. Furthermore, he was selected for inclusion in the Top Lawyers in Colorado Springs list by the Colorado Springs Magazine.

An eloquent speaker, Mr. Graham is frequently requested to present on military family law and other related topics at several conferences and seminars, including those sponsored by the El Paso County Bar Association and the American Academy of Matrimonial Lawyers.

Mr. Graham is an active member of the Colorado Bar Association – Family Law Section and Military & Veterans Affairs Committee and the Ben S. Wendelken American Inn of Court. He is the former trustee and treasurer of the El Paso County Bar Association.

*AV®, AV Preeminent®, Martindale-Hubbell Distinguished and Martindale-Hubbell Notable are certification marks used under license in accordance with the Martindale-Hubbell certification procedures, standards and policies. Martindale-Hubbell® is the facilitator of a peer review rating process. Ratings reflect the anonymous opinions of members of the bar and the judiciary. Martindale-Hubbell® Peer Review Rating™ fall into two categories – legal ability and general ethical standards.
